target_customer: Urban drivers (free app), with revenue from a paid Plus tier, garage deals and licensing parking maps to carmakers
problem: Street parking rules, street cleaning and ticket risk are confusing. SpotAngels crowdsources data to find free parking and avoid tickets.
business_model: Freemium consumer app; garage deal commissions, subscription and data licensing

founders.name: Thomas Cottin
founders.background_notes: Only founder on the YC page. A search snippet from an aggregator names other founders (Hamza Ouazzani Chahdi, Aboud Jardaneh, Mehdi Sqalli) which I could not verify in an opened source.

technical_complexity.rationale: Crowdsourced data, parking detection via sensors, later computer vision on dashcam footage for availability.

defensibility.rationale: Crowdsourced rules and availability data improve with users, though maps and rules data are available publicly.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No dated source on incumbent action; the company was still independent in 2018 and later.

market_need_then: Not sourced for 2014. Later TechCrunch 2018 says the app worked in 20 US cities.

branding.brand_signature: Waze for parking positioning, quoted by TechCrunch as the Waze of parking
branding.community_and_virality: Press quotes from TimeOut, Forbes, TechCrunch, NY Post and Fox 5 per the company site; claims millions of users.

brand_strength.rationale: Clear category analogy and coverage by multiple outlets; evidence is on the company's own site.

outcome_analysis: SpotAngels is a small team (11 per YC) that grew a crowdsourced parking app to about 20 cities by 2018 and raised 2.3 million dollars from Google Maps veterans and YC. It stays free for drivers and has not been reported acquired or shut down. The size of the business and later funding are not verified.
notes: Funding cross check: TechCrunch and a FinSMEs result agree on a 2.3M 2018 round (FinSMEs not opened). Bouncewatch lists a 2.0M seed on 2017-10-17 and a 2020 seed, unverified aggregator data, not recorded. Outcome search was polluted by unrelated results and found no acquisition. Name origin search found nothing. No dated competitor source from 2014 so list is empty. Medium article returned 403.
